item.title: Linux sed Stream Editor Hands-on: Pattern Space and Hold Space
item.description: An in-depth analysis of the core architecture of sed (Stream Editor), systematically reviewing common options and editing actions, deeply dissecting the interaction mechanism between Pattern Space and Hold Space, and demonstrating multi-editing, inverted selection, and batch configuration cleanup based on enterprise practical cases.

item.title: Linux Hands-on Basics: Regular Expressions (BRE/ERE) and grep Text Filtering
item.description: A systematic review of Basic Regular Expressions (BRE) and Extended Regular Expressions (ERE) in Linux operations, deeply analyzing grep text filtering commands based on the dawn host across 14 core practical cases.
